gizmo.title: Ukuqalisa ithuluzi langaphandle
gizmo.description: Ibhlokhi evula ithuluzi lokufunda langaphandle ewindini elisha noma ekhasini, njengesixhumanisi esivamile noma ngesicelo sokungena se-LTI 1.3.

configure.title: Incazelo
configure.description: Lokho abafundi abakwenzayo kuthuluzi, okuboniswa ngaphezu kwenkinobho.

configure.title: I-URL yokuqalisa
configure.description: Ikheli lethuluzi. Kumele kube yikheli eliphelele eliqala nge-https:// noma nge-http://.

configure.title: Vula ku-
configure.description: Iwindi elisha lisebenza nawo wonke amathuluzi. Kuleli khasi kusebenza kuphela namathuluzi avumela ukuboniswa ngaphakathi kwenye isayithi.

advanced.title: I-URL yokungena ye-LTI
advanced.description: I-LTI 1.3 kuphela: ikheli lokuqalisa ukungena kwethuluzi. Ngalokhu, i-ID yeklayenti ne-ID yokusatshalaliswa, inkinobho ithumela isicelo sokungena se-LTI esikhundleni sokuvula isixhumanisi esivamile. Ukuqeda ukuqalisa kudinga isevisi ye-LTI yale sayithi.

advanced.title: I-ID yeklayenti ye-LTI
advanced.description: I-ID yeklayenti ithuluzi elinikeze yona le sayithi. Isihlonzi somphakathi, hhayi imfihlo: ungalokothi ubeke okhiye noma izimfihlo lapha.

advanced.title: I-ID yokusatshalaliswa ye-LTI
advanced.description: I-ID yokusatshalaliswa ithuluzi elinikeze yona le sayithi. Isihlonzi somphakathi, hhayi imfihlo.

advanced.title: Umkhiphi we-LTI
advanced.description: Ikheli elihlonza le sayithi kuthuluzi. Shiya kungenalutho ukuze usebenzise ikheli lesayithi ikhasi elikuyo.

advanced.title: Ukuphakama ekhasini
advanced.description: Ukuphakama kwethuluzi uma livuleka kuleli khasi, ngamaphikseli (200 kuya ku-2000).

advanced.title: Umbala wokugcizelela
advanced.description: Umbala we-chip yesihloko nenkinobho. Shiya kungenalutho ukuze kulandele itimu.

developer.title: Isicebiso sokungena se-LTI
developer.description: Inani elingacacile isevisi ye-LTI yale sayithi elisebenzisayo ukuze ibone umfundi. Ngokuvamile linikezwa yisayithi ngomcimbi we-lti-launch-request kunokuba lilondolozwe lapha. Akulona neze iphasiwedi noma ukhiye.

developer.title: Isicebiso somlayezo se-LTI
developer.description: Inani elingacacile isevisi ye-LTI yale sayithi elisebenzisayo ukuze ibone lokhu kuqalisa. Ngokuvamile linikezwa yisayithi kunokuba lilondolozwe lapha.
